chunk.content: Scomberomorus commerson (Spanish mackerel), one candidate species within the ambiguous tenggiri label, has a strong, distinctly fishy flavour, medium to very high oiliness, medium-dry firm flesh and few bones that are easily removed.
chunk.source_quote: Has a strong, distinctly 'fishy' flavour, medium to very high oiliness and medium-dry, firm flesh ... has few bones, which are easily removed.
